_doc: Explicit encoding contract per model. encode.py refuses any model not listed here.
status: verified   = golden example (scripts/golden_check.py) passed; record date+versions in 'verified'.
unverified = rules from a named source; allowed, but every output sidecar says so.
blocked    = a known open question; encode.py refuses unless --allow-blocked.
prefixes are literal strings prepended to the text; prompt names refer to the model's own
sentence-transformers prompts. pooling/padding_side/normalize are EXPECTED values: encode.py
compares them with the loaded model, enforces padding_side and add_eos, and records everything.
revision: pin a commit hash before any run whose numbers reach the paper.

BAAI/bge-m3.notes: RESOLVED 2026-11-01: re-encoded under this contract and now scores Recall@10 0.8468 on the 1M MS MARCO subsample, above MiniLM's 0.8245 (it had scored 0.695 before, below MiniLM, because of the query prefix the old emb_cache used). Document self-retrieval top-1 = 1.0, padding check ok, no shims. Still 'unverified' rather than 'verified': no golden check has been run for it.

Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B.notes: Instruction-tuned; Thaw resolve_prefixes has no rule and warns. Resolve the query prompt (model's own 'query' prompt vs a task-specific 'Instruct: ...\nQuery:'), EOS handling and padding with the golden check before use.
Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B._note: 2026-11-09: filled from the model card, which matches the 8B contract field for field: last-token pooling, padding_side left (the card's own tokenizer call), query instruction 'Instruct: {task}\nQuery:{query}' with the same web-search task, no document prefix, 1024 dims, transformers>=4.51. Revision unpinned: encode.py records the commit it loaded in the sidecar; pin it here after the first encode. Unverified like the 8B (no reproducible worked example on the card); encode_check.py's self-retrieval and collapse checks are the acceptance test. Used only for the optional LLM->LLM pair P5r.
Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B._note_2026_11_09: query_prefix emptied: the model's own prompts.query is the same Instruct string and query_prompt_name='query' already applies it; with both, queries carried the instruction twice. Encodings made before this change are stale (encode_check fails them).

Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-8B.notes: NQ runs scored below MiniLM; sentence-transformers tokenizer reported padding_side=right; ran under tfcompat. Golden check in a clean, card-pinned environment first.
Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-8B._note: 2026-11-06: filled from the model's own 1_Pooling/config.json (pooling_mode_lasttoken, dim 4096) and config_sentence_transformers.json (prompts.query = the Instruct string, prompts.document = empty). padding_side=left because it is decoder-only and pools at the last token. The block note said the 1M run's tokenizer reported 'right', which is exactly the left/right mismatch this contract fixes. Stays unverified: the card prints MTEB aggregates only, so there is no reproducible worked example for golden_check.py.

codesage/codesage-small.notes: Remote code. Check whether the card requires an EOS token (add_eos) and the pooling; then golden check. NOTE: the 2026-11-01 code pair (P7) was encoded and run with this contract still 'blocked', i.e. via --allow-blocked, and no sidecar for it is in the results archive. Run encode_check.py on it before any number from P7 is quoted - it is the only cross-domain evidence there is.
codesage/codesage-small._note: 2026-11-06: unblocked with an explicit contract plus three API-drift aliases (compat/sitecustomize.py via PYTHONPATH; no repo code changed). Contract from the card: add_eos_token=True is required; the repo ships no 1_Pooling so SentenceTransformer falls back to mean pooling (probe: no Pooling module, dim = hidden). Verified on 512 docs: padding check min cos 1.0, self-retrieval top1 1.0. The old block note about codesage-base 'own queries 0.79' was measured without add_eos; with it the query path self-retrieves perfectly.
